messages:
Emma: quick UX check — noticed the in-product docs flyout doesn't restore focus on close. when opened from a dashboard metric card, pressing Esc returns you to the page but focus is lost. can we restore focus to the card or triggering element? :thinking:

Raj: seen that during keyboard testing. we set DocsFlyout with focusTrap=true but never save lastActiveElement on open.

Sarah: while we're here I can tighten the copy. quick note: the flyout uses the term 'Model profile' but the console surface reads 'Model details'. that mismatch will confuse customers.

Jordan: +1 on unifying language. pick 'Model details' for clarity. also external links inside the flyout open a new tab; we should surface an icon and add an aria-label like 'opens in new tab'.

Raj: implementation details: anchors are currently written as <a target='_blank' rel='noopener'> with no aria-label. easy fix. for focus restore plan: on open do last = document.activeElement; on close call last?.focus(); add small setTimeout to avoid route change races.

Sarah: can we also make the flyout support deep links like .../guides#kv-cache so the flyout can open on a specific section? that'd be useful when linking from external docs.

Emma: deep-linking is a must. UX ask: if someone follows a deep link from hosted docs into the console, the flyout should open and the relevant heading should be highlighted (outline + aria-live='polite' announcement: 'Showing section: KV cache') so screen reader users know where they landed.

Jordan: accessibility nit: the flyout has role='dialog' but missing aria-labelledby on the heading. add that and make the close button the first tabbable element with aria-label='Close docs'.

LighthouseBot: accessibility check: contrast failure on the callout badge in docs (3.8:1). suggest color update to meet 4.5:1.

Sarah: proposed copy tweak for top paragraph: 'Redwood inference runtimes maintain KV caches to reduce token cost — see "KV cache" in Model details for config examples.' (shorter, links to the model details section)

Raj: PR ready: fix/docs-flyout-focus-1799 — saves/restores lastActiveElement, adds aria-labels for external links, adds aria-labelledby and makes close button tabbable.

Emma: two follow-ups: 1) add a unit/e2e test that simulates keyboard open/close and asserts focus returns 2) product review for the copy swap across Console + docs pipeline.

Jordan: small micro-UX idea: when a link opens a new tab show a toast 'Opening documentation in a new tab' with an action to return to Console. helpful but optional.

Sarah: draft toast copy: 'Opening docs in a new tab — click to return to Console.'

Emma: tagging @design for final QA and @eng-oncall FYI for the deploy window. :thumbsup:

Jordan: QA checklist: keyboard nav, focus restoration, sr announcement for highlighted section, aria-labels on external links, contrast check.

Raj: deploying to staging now. will drop staging link and a quick screencap of keyboard flow when live.

Emma: thanks — please post staging link + short screencap. will use for docs screenshots.
